goal: Explain how the analyze framework under src/analyze is structured: its sub-modules, entrypoints, dependency tree and per-module functional surface.

tasks.rationale: Enumerate every source-holding directory under src/analyze so the per-module surface tasks and the aggregator work from a verified module list.
The module profile returned zero exports and symbol.locate was skipped; enumerate entrypoints (index.ts, runAnalyze) to establish the public surface.
Walk the dependency graph rooted at src/analyze to show how its nine subdirectories depend on each other and on shared/db/config.
The orchestrator holds runAnalyze (driver.ts) and RunAnalyzeArgs; its surface shows how the pipeline stages are sequenced end to end.
Surface of the classifier sub-module, the stage that turns a request into a classified intent (target, scope, focus).
The context sub-module defines AnalyzeContextBundle and the boot validator; its surface explains how the context bundle is built.
Surface of the explore sub-module, which holds the exploration recipes (concept.resolve, module.profile, import.graph and others).
Surface of the planner sub-module, which builds and validates the Plan Task from the intent, bundle and task catalog.
Surface of the executor sub-module, which runs the planned tasks serially and materialises their outputs for the aggregator.
Surface of the runtimes sub-module, to show which per-template task runtimes exist and how the executor reaches them.
Surface of the summariser sub-module, the post-indexing summary stage that feeds doc summaries into analyze runs.
Stitch the module list, entrypoints, dependency tree and the eight per-module surfaces into one structural report of the analyze framework.

reasoning: Focused S-scope structural question anchored on src/analyze. Three discovery/structure tasks establish the module list, entrypoints (the profile returned no exports) and the dependency tree; then one functional-surface task per non-test subdirectory (orchestrator, classifier, context, explore, planner, executor, runtimes, summariser), deep on the four that carry the pipeline's core types. The aggregator stitches all of it. Omitted: __tests__, adherence checks (no doc constraints asked for), and planner-kind deep-dives, which S scope does not warrant.
